entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is this the same kinda thing as earlier?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It should be, for the most part.[n]Give it a try, Joker.

entries.speaker: Scornful Young Man
entries.en: Hey, why're you guys on that side?[n]You really think you'll gain anything[n]over there?

entries.speaker: Scornful Young Man
entries.en: You must be idiots, huh? Maybe you[n]should be smarter about how you're[n]living your life.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Happiness is much more than simply[n]"gaining" things.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To be honest, I can't believe he's actually[n]enjoying his life here...

entries.speaker: Stern Businessman
entries.en: There are standards. Laws. Rules.[n]Manners. Common sense.

entries.speaker: Stern Businessman
entries.en: Following those things is the only correct[n]way of living. What is there to be confused[n]about?

entries.speaker: Stern Businessman
entries.en: Anyone who can't do that is just an[n]outcast. All you really have to do is[n]obey the rules...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How pathetic... He should be more aware[n]of his own situation...

entries.speaker: Exhausted Young Man
entries.en: In the long term, your struggles will[n]transform into nourishment. All you[n]need do is endure...

entries.speaker: Exhausted Young Man
entries.en: No matter how much they beat or kick[n]you... it is all for your own self-benefit[n]in the end...

entries.speaker: Exhausted Young Man
entries.en: If anything, I should feel thankful...[n]This is exactly what I deserve...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I had the exact same mindset in the past...
